name: Tinkerclaw Browser Relay
description: Chrome extension for sharing browser tabs with Jarvis. Tabs are grouped in a brown 'Tinker Shared' tab group.

bindHost.description: Interface the extension relay listens on. Keep 127.0.0.1 for a browser on this machine. Use a LAN address or 0.0.0.0 to let a Chrome on another machine share tabs — that requires gateway.auth.token to be set, otherwise the relay refuses to start.
